exercises.q: What happened on the motorway?
exercises.text: Last Saturday we set off early for a trip to the mountains. Unfortunately, our car broke down on the motorway, so we had to call for help. While we were waiting, it started to rain. Despite this, we didn't give up. A mechanic arrived after an hour and fixed the problem quickly. We finally got to the hotel in the evening, tired but happy. The next day the weather cleared up and we spent the whole day hiking. In the end, it turned out to be a great weekend.

exercises.q: When are night owls usually more creative?
exercises.text: Many people find it hard to get up early. However, scientists say that some of us are simply "night owls". Although night owls often feel tired in the morning, they are usually more creative in the evening. On the other hand, "early birds" tend to be more productive before lunch. Because of this, some companies now let employees choose their working hours. This means that night owls can start later, while early birds can finish work in the afternoon.
